anemone.title: An anemone plant (Anemone species): three flowers and a leaf. Etching by N. Robert, c. 1660, after himself.

anemone-lys.title: An anemone (Anemone species) and lily (Lilium species): flowering stems with butterfly. Etching by N. Robert, c. 1660, after himself.

bouquet-ancien.title: Four plants, including feverfew (Tanacetum species) and a tulip (Tulipa variegata): flowering stems. Etching by N. Robert, c. 1660, after himself.

muflier.title: A plant (Antirrhinum orontium) related to snapdragon: flowering stem, roots and floral segments. Coloured engraving after J. Sowerby, 1803.

graminee.title: Quaking grass (Briza media): flowering stem, leaves and floral segments. Coloured engraving after J. Sowerby, 1796.

dahlia.title: A garden dahlia (Dahlia variabilis): one large flower. Coloured engraving, c. 1842.

eucalyptus.title: Blue gum or fever tree (Eucalyptus globulus Labill.): flowering and fruiting stem with floral segments. Engraving by C. Dien, c.1798, after P. J. Redouté.

fougere.title: The male fern (Dryopteris filix-mas): fronds and part of rhizome. Colour nature print by A. Auer, c. 1853.

iris.title: A variegated tulip (Tulipa species) and blue flag iris (Iris versicolor): flowering stems. Etching by N. Robert, c. 1660, after himself.

bleuet.title: Three plants, including a cornflower (Centaurea cyanus) and an iris: flowering stems with two grasshoppers. Etching by N. Robert, c. 1660, after himself.

lys.title: White lily striped with purple (Lilium sp.) and two irises (Iris sp.) Coloured engraving by H. Fletcher, c. 1730, after J. van Huysum.

olivier.title: Olive (Olea europaea) and Russian olive (Elaeagnus angustifolia): flowering branches and floral segments. Colour and coloured mezzotint, c. 1741.

pivoine.title: Double and single paeony (Paeonia sp.): flowering stem of the double peony with a separate single paeony flower and floral segments. Engraving by Hopwood, c.1802, after P.Henderson.

renoncule.title: Buttercup (Ranunculus grandiflorus): flowering stem and flowers. Etching, c. 1718, after C. Aubriet.

eglantier.title: Dog rose (Rosa canina): flowering stem, leaf and fruit. Coloured engraving, c. 1829, after J. Sowerby.

rose.title: Dog rose (Rosa canina): flowering stem, flower, fruit and bud. Coloured engraving, c. 1830, after J. Sowerby.

magnolia.title: A Magnolia species: flowering stem with labelled floral segments, fruit and seed. Coloured etching by G. D. Ehret, c.1737, after himself.

tulipe.title: A leopard's bane plant (Doronicum species) and tulip (Tulipa species): flowering stems and a grasshopper. Etching by N. Robert, c. 1660, after himself.

brins.title: Two sprigs of flowers, including tulip and honeysuckle, meant as designs for embroidery. Etching with engraving after W. Kilburn, 1775.

violette.title: A violet (Viola lutea): flowering stem. Etching by N. Robert, c. 1660, after himself.

martagon.title: A Turk's-cap lily (Lilium martagon), a harebell (Campanula rotundifolia) and a pansy (Viola species): flowering stems. Etching by N. Robert, c. 1660, after himself.

pensee.title: Heart's-ease (Viola tricolor) and germander speedwell (Veronica chamaedrys): entire flowering plants. Coloured etching by A. Duménil, c. 1865, after P. Naudin.

julienne.title: Damask (Hesperis matronalis L.): flowering and fruiting stem with separate floral segments, fruit and seeds. Coloured etching by M. Bouchard, 177-.
